items.name: portrait-beetles-worker
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: TINKER, the beetles' worker: a small, round, friendly dung beetle head of glossy black chitin with big shiny eyes and tiny mandibles, a royal-blue and brass shoulder plate, and its huge brass wrench resting over its shoulder so the wrench's open jaw rises beside its head. Signature feature: the open brass wrench jaw beside a smooth, hornless round head.

items.name: portrait-beetles-shieldbearer
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: SHIELDBEARER, the front-line tank: a rhinoceros beetle head of glossy black chitin with one tall curved black horn rising from its snout, big glossy black eyes, heavy royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, and beside it the crenellated top edge of its riveted royal-blue tower shield with a steel boss. Signature feature: the single tall rhino horn.

items.name: portrait-beetles-bolter
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: BOLTER, the ranged soldier: a stocky beetle head of glossy black chitin under a rounded black steel helm banded with brass, big glossy black eyes and two short curved brass-tipped mandibles, royal-blue shoulder plates, and the brass muzzles of its six-barrel pressure repeater thrust toward the lower left, one wisp of white steam. Signature feature: the cluster of repeater muzzles. No horn.

items.name: portrait-beetles-breacher
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: BREACHER, the siege trooper: a heavy beetle head of glossy black chitin with two big curved black horns sweeping up and inward like pincers, big glossy eyes, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, and the ridged steel cone of its siege drill thrusting diagonally toward the lower left. Signature feature: the twin pincer horns over the drill tip.

items.name: portrait-beetles-arcwright
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: ARCWRIGHT, the substance specialist: a slim, narrow beetle head of glossy black chitin with two long sweeping antennae and big glossy eyes, a royal-blue hooded mantle with a brass collar, and its brass coil lance held upright beside the head, one bold violet arc crackling at the coiled tip. Signature feature: the coil lance with its violet arc. No horn.

items.name: portrait-beetles-mender
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: MENDER, the field medic and mechanic: a round beetle head of glossy black chitin wearing big round brass goggles, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, a jointed brass welding-torch arm curving over the head with a small bright white-blue flame at its nozzle, and the violet glass barrel of its syringe-gun at the lower left edge. Signature feature: the round goggles under the torch arm.

items.name: portrait-beetles-warden
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: WARDEN, the shield specialist: a beetle head of glossy black chitin with big glossy eyes under a brass-framed helmet crowned with a domed violet glass window, royal-blue shoulder plates, and across the lower part of the frame the brass-framed top edge of its curved translucent violet barrier pane. Signature feature: the violet barrier pane in front of the face.

items.name: portrait-beetles-bombard
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: BOMBARD, the siege crawler: the wide, short brass-rimmed mortar barrel aiming up toward the upper left out of a domed royal-blue armoured hull with riveted brass bands, a violet glass band around the mortar's base, a small beetle crewman's head peeking from the round hatch behind, the hull's black beetle face with two glossy eyes at the front. Signature feature: the open mortar mouth. No legs.

items.name: portrait-beetles-steamwing
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: STEAMWING, the flyer: a black beetle in a brass boiler wing rig, its glossy black face and eyes in the centre, two wide royal-blue membrane wings on brass spars spread to both sides, three short brass chimneys on its back puffing one plume of white steam, a violet glass beam emitter under its chin. Signature feature: the spread blue wings.

items.name: portrait-beetles-juggernaut
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: JUGGERNAUT, the walking fortress: the massive front of a royal-blue armoured beetle hull, a big round violet furnace window with a brass cross-frame glowing in the middle of its brow, two heavy brass cannon muzzles below on either side, riveted steel and brass bands. Signature feature: the round violet furnace window. No legs, no crew.

items.name: portrait-beetles-hornbreaker
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: HORNBREAKER, the beetle warlord: a Hercules beetle head of glossy black chitin whose long curved black horn sweeps high up and forward, a brass brow band with a violet gem, big glossy eyes, a royal-blue cape and brass-trimmed royal-blue pauldrons, and the steel-and-brass head of his great hammer with a violet glass core on his shoulder. Signature feature: the towering Hercules horn.

items.name: portrait-beetles-coilkeeper
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: COILKEEPER, the substance savant: a slender beetle head of glossy black chitin with big glossy eyes, a royal-blue hood with brass trim, and behind her head a brass ring halo studded with seven copper coils like a crown of spools; beside her at the left, the brass lantern of her staff with violet substance glowing inside its glass. Signature feature: the copper coil halo.

items.name: portrait-beetles-forgemaster
items.refnote: the first image is the unit's approved concept: keep its head, materials and colours, but paint only the head and shoulders as described below and ignore its full-body pose, legs, background and staging.
items.subject: FORGEMASTER, the engineer: a broad beetle head of glossy black chitin under a tall crenellated brass smokestack helm with one thin wisp of smoke, round brass goggles with blue lenses, short tusk mandibles, royal-blue plates, and a jointed brass arm rig rising over his shoulder carrying a small repeater turret. Signature feature: the tall smokestack helm.
